assets.displayName: Approved Hegemony emblem for the Tervain menu

source.creationDisclosure: Supplied filename identifies a ChatGPT image; no specific generation model or service version independently verified.

runtime.preparation: Byte-exact copy; no crop, repaint, background removal or metadata stripping; caBX chunk retained.
runtime.intendedUse: The single Hegemony standard in the native 3D menu (desert market in 0.0.4; Templar vigil since 0.0.5, A26); base-URL-aware loading. Since A75 the game loads the 512 px derivative below; this master stays in the repository unchanged.
runtime.renderPreparation: Since 0.0.5 the renderer draws the unchanged master into a canvas at runtime and weathers the copy for the one standard (A24): lower saturation and value, rubbed-thin patches, weave and mud over the cloth, and a matching light-through map in which the emblem blocks the low sun. No other surface carries the emblem. The bundled PNG is not modified.

terms.tervainAuthority: Owner explicitly confirmed Templars as part of Hegemony and requested the approved emblem in the Tervain menu on 2026-09-30 (A21-A22).
terms.credit: Hegemony emblem supplied by Ael for the Warpkeep project; preserved from the September 27 source archive.
terms.boundary: Specific Tervain menu-use authorization; no general open-content, third-party, trademark, endorsement or unrelated-asset grant asserted.

verification.sceneIntegrationAndVisualQa: 0.0.4: rendered on native fabric in local production-preview review. 0.0.5: rendered weathered on the vigil standard in local headless-browser captures; CPU tests cover print, missing-image fallback and late-load-after-dispose. Combined production-browser reviews passed on b2a62ab and, after the late placement/frame integration, f0dc24c; actual coverage is recorded in docs/production/releases/0.0.5.md.
verification.fallbackAndDisposal: Six CPU-only scene regression tests; no browser HTTP-failure simulation performed.
verification.publication: Integrated and locally validated on f0dc24c; source published on codex/0-0-5-templar-forest. PR #4 is merged; this source record tracks the late follow-up branch. Public Pages hosting is unavailable (deploy 404; private:true, has_pages:false). See docs/production/releases/0.0.5.md#publication.

runtimeDerivative.preparation: A75: the master above resized to 512 px (Lanczos) and encoded as WebP (quality 92, full alpha quality) with sharp; the banner canvas it is painted into is 384 px wide, so no visible detail is lost. Saves about 1.1 MiB before the title screen.
